native_v1.editor_exit: SIGTRAP after End of painter-editor tests
native_v1.diagnostic: Gimp-Core-FATAL-CRITICAL: gimp_fill_options_new: assertion 'use_context_color == FALSE || context != NULL' failed
native_v1.cause: Final test fixture restored brush paths and left normal RC autosave queued. gimp_rc_dispose flushes the save after gimp_exit clears user_context; RC construction needs that context.
native_v1.correction: Test closes its two editors before restoring paths, drains normal main-loop idle while context is live, and asserts config/edit_config save_idle_id are zero. No production shutdown behavior or autosave setting changed. Clean terminal exits are required; native v2 passed, sanitizer v2 timed out and is separately retained. Final acceptance uses v3 in both modes.

baseline_visual_v1.diagnostic: Dockable action encountered native gimp_dockable_new help_id != NULL because registration supplies NULL; subsequent quit failed its normal bound. Causation of final exit is not established.
baseline_visual_v1.correction: Clean baseline-02 and candidate-01 use working ordinary tool-options popup. Separate dockable help-ID defect remains open and excluded.
